description: This file defines the RetryMiddlewareV2 class used for handling retries of failed AWS SDK HTTP requests. It includes logic for retry decision making, error classification, and delay strategies, supporting both 'standard' and 'adaptive' modes.

classes.name: RetryMiddlewareV2
classes.description: Middleware class responsible for handling request retries with support for different modes and error handling strategies.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Factory method to create middleware with configuration and options.

methods.name: createDefaultDecider
methods.description: Creates the default decision function to determine if a request should be retried based on the result and errors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the retry middleware with configuration, handler, and options.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main handler function invoked during request execution, implementing retry logic via promises.

methods.name: exponentialDelayWithJitter
methods.description: Calculates delay with exponential backoff plus jitter for retry attempts.

methods.name: isRetryable
methods.description: Determines whether an error or response is retryable based on error codes and response status.

methods.name: isThrottlingError
methods.description: Checks if a result indicates a throttling error.
